messages.author: 87cf4991b6a810ee
messages.subject: Custom legends
parts:
Is there a way to make custom legends with ggplot2? What I am looking to do is something similar to what could be done with lattice where one use essentially and grob as a legend and position it where ever they want on the plot. I need to be able to do this with ggplot2.

--
Ryan Hope, M.S.
CogWorks Lab
Cognitive Science Department
Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Custom legends
parts:
You can customize legends. I would take a look at the documentation to see if what you are looking to do is possible. If you don't see something, then post again with a more question.

I would start here:
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/guide_legend.html
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/guide_colourbar.html
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/theme.html
